newsitem.title: UK: GKN shares rise, earnings upgrades seen.
newsitem.headline: GKN shares rise, earnings upgrades seen.

text.p: Shares in British engineering group GKN opened sharply higher on Wednesday after the company reported half-year profits above analysts' best expectations.
The shares opened 37p, or 3.4 percent, higher at 11.23 stg.
SocGen analyst Andy Chambers said, "The numbers looked very good. The aerospace division has done much better than expected and I imagine the shares will have a positive reaction."
Earlier, GKN said interim pre-tax profits had risen 12.2 percent to 203 million stg, above the consensus forecast of 189 million stg and overshooting a top forecast of 200 million stg.
An interim dividend of 10.5p was also slightly better than most analysts were hoping for.
"We're expecting earnings upgrades of about five percent," said one trader.
GKN said the negative impact of the strong pound on profits was 18 million stg, above the 10 million originally anticipated.
